title: The Court of Ten Heads
text: At the end of the last shrine a king sits on a throne of gold, and every one of his ten faces turns to look at you at once. Each mouth is smiling a different smile. He offers cunning to anyone who will call him master, and asks that you leave him a little of your judgement.

options.label: Kneel and call him master, for cunning no mortal teacher could give.

outcomes.text: Ten voices whisper their tricks into you at once. You leave cleverer than you came, though never again certain which thoughts are your own.

options.label: Refuse him, all ten faces of him, and see which one frowns first.

outcomes.text: All ten faces frown at once. He rises from the throne, taller than any man.

options.label: Learn his cunning and never bow. Let him see how well you learn.

outcomes.text: The Leader learns the trick without bowing. Nine of the heads laugh at such boldness; the tenth only watches.
One of the heads saw it coming. The trick turns in the Leader's hands and spreads through every mind in the party.
